name: Corporate Action 94
definition: Provides information about the corporate action event.

DateDetails.name: Date Details
DateDetails.definition: Provides information about the dates related to a corporate action event.

PeriodDetails.name: Period Details
PeriodDetails.definition: Provides information about the periods related to a corporate action event.

RateAndAmountDetails.name: Rate And Amount Details
RateAndAmountDetails.definition: Provides information about rates and amounts related to a corporate action event.

PriceDetails.name: Price Details
PriceDetails.definition: Provides information about the prices related to a corporate action event.

SecuritiesQuantity.name: Securities Quantity
SecuritiesQuantity.definition: Provides information about securities quantity linked to a corporate action.

InterestAccruedNumberOfDays.name: Interest Accrued Number Of Days
InterestAccruedNumberOfDays.definition: Number of days used for calculating the accrued interest amount.

CouponNumber.name: Coupon Number
CouponNumber.definition: Number of the coupon attached/associated with a security.

AcceptancePriorityLevel.name: Acceptance Priority Level
AcceptancePriorityLevel.definition: Level of priority of the given offer which will be accepted by the issuer/agent within the tiered structure of the event.|Offer events in many cases are subject to proration.

CertificationBreakdownIndicator.name: Certification Breakdown Indicator
CertificationBreakdownIndicator.definition: Indicates whether certification/breakdown is required. |Yes = certification required.|No = no certification required.

ChargesAppliedIndicator.name: Charges Applied Indicator
ChargesAppliedIndicator.definition: Indicates whether charges apply to the holder, for instance redemption charges.

RestrictionIndicator.name: Restriction Indicator
RestrictionIndicator.definition: Indicates whether restrictions apply to the corporate action event or not.

AccruedInterestIndicator.name: Accrued Interest Indicator
AccruedInterestIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the holder is entitled to accrued interest.

ForfeitureOfInterestIndicator.name: Forfeiture Of Interest Indicator
ForfeitureOfInterestIndicator.definition: Indicates that bondholders who convert between record date and payable date will forfeit their interest.

LetterOfGuaranteedDeliveryIndicator.name: Letter Of Guaranteed Delivery Indicator
LetterOfGuaranteedDeliveryIndicator.definition: Indicates whether a letter of guaranteed delivery can be submitted in order to participate in the offer on full eligible position. It is not intended for use in situations arising from failed or late trades.

ShareholderRightsDirectiveIndicator.name: Shareholder Rights Directive Indicator
ShareholderRightsDirectiveIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the announcement was initiated by the first intermediary in the custody chain in accordance with SRD II.

DividendType.name: Dividend Type
DividendType.definition: Specifies the conditions in which a dividend is paid.

EventSequenceType.name: Event Sequence Type
EventSequenceType.definition: Specifies whether the event is an interim or a final event in a series of predefined or planned events of the same type and for the same underlying instrument.

OccurrenceType.name: Occurrence Type
OccurrenceType.definition: Specifies the conditions in which the instructions and/or payment of the proceeds occurs.

OfferType.name: Offer Type
OfferType.definition: Specifies the conditions that apply to the offer.

RenounceableEntitlementStatusType.name: Renounceable Entitlement Status Type
RenounceableEntitlementStatusType.definition: Specifies whether terms of the event allow resale of the rights.

EventStage.name: Event Stage
EventStage.definition: Stage in the corporate action event life cycle.

AdditionalBusinessProcessIndicator.name: Additional Business Process Indicator
AdditionalBusinessProcessIndicator.definition: Specifies the type of the additional business process linked to the corporate action event such as a claim compensation or tax refund.

ChangeType.name: Change Type
ChangeType.definition: Specifies the type of change announced.

FollowingEventTypeIndicator.name: Following Event Type Indicator
FollowingEventTypeIndicator.definition: Specifies the event type of the following event.

CapitalGainInOutIndicator.name: Capital Gain In Out Indicator
CapitalGainInOutIndicator.definition: Specifies whether the capital gain is in the scope of the EU Savings directive for the income realised upon the sale, refund or redemption of shares and units (.) (Article 6(1d)).

TaxableIncomePerShareCalculated.name: Taxable Income Per Share Calculated
TaxableIncomePerShareCalculated.definition: Specifies whether the financial instrument calculates the taxable income per dividend/taxable income per share.

ElectionType.name: Election Type
ElectionType.definition: Specifies the effect on the holdings of electing a corporate action option.

LotteryType.name: Lottery Type
LotteryType.definition: Specifies the type of lottery announced.

CertificationType.name: Certification Type
CertificationType.definition: Specifies the certification format required, this is, physical or electronic format.

ConsentType.name: Consent Type
ConsentType.definition: Specifies the type of consent announced.

InformationType.name: Information Type
InformationType.definition: Specifies the type of information event.

TaxOnNonDistributedProceedsIndicator.name: Tax On Non Distributed Proceeds Indicator
TaxOnNonDistributedProceedsIndicator.definition: Specifies the tax regulation being attributed to the non-distributed proceeds event or to any other event.

DutchAuctionType.name: Dutch Auction Type
DutchAuctionType.definition: Specifies whether a Dutch auction is modified or unmodified.

ReverseDutchAuctionIndicator.name: Reverse Dutch Auction Indicator
ReverseDutchAuctionIndicator.definition: Indicates that the Dutch Auction event is a Reverse Dutch Auction.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Provides additional information. This field may only be used when the information to be transmitted, cannot be coded.

DissenterRights1UGRule.definition: If OfferType/Code value is equal to DISS (DissenterRights), then OfferType/Code value equal to NDIS (DissenterRightsNotApplicable) is not allowed in any occurrence of OfferType.|(MT 564 NVR C27)

DissenterRights2UGRule.definition: If OfferType/Code value is equal to NDIS (DissenterRightsNotApplicable), then OfferType/Code value equal to DISS (DissenterRights) is not allowed in any occurrence of OfferType.|(MT 564 NVR C27)

DissenterRights1Rule.definition: If OfferType/Code value is equal to DISS (DissenterRights), then OfferType/Code value equal to NDIS (DissenterRightsNotApplicable) is not allowed in any occurrence of OfferType.|(MT 564 NVR C27)

DissenterRights2Rule.definition: If OfferType/Code value is equal to NDISS (DissenterRightsNotApplicable), then OfferType/Code value equal to DISS (DissenterRights) is not allowed in any occurrence of OfferType.|(MT 564 NVR C27)

AcceptancePriorityLevelUGRule.definition: If OfferType/Code is equal to AcceptancePriority (ACPR), then AcceptancePriorityLevel must be present.
